name: Yuuki Hikari
source:
Maito's senpai. An intellectual girl who works for the head of the department of literature. Though she tries to be cool and collected, she has a vulgar and short-tempered side. 

[Based on [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=600425]Getchu[/url]]
